text:
lee: Alert: apac-proxy mTLS failures spiking, handshake_ok=false with kms unwrap errors. Anyone touch key rotation or RBAC? :alarm_clock:

ops-bot: ALERT: mtls_handshake_rate_drop service=proxy-apac window=15m value=82% runbook=eng-security/mtls

jess: I ran the nightly ephemeral key rotation job last night. I recall toggling audit sampling down to 10% to reduce log costs. Patch ref: infra/rotate-2026-03-20-11.

maria: Can you paste the proxy logs?

lee: Logs show: `2026-03-23T05:12:07Z proxy-apac auth=mtls handshake_ok=false err="kms.UnwrapError: access denied" key=projects/redwood/locations/asia/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/ephemeral-20260323` then `certstore.unable_to_unwrap`

jess: That key name looks like the rotation created a new key resource. I may not have copied the IAM binding for proxy-keystore SA.

maria: If sampling is at 10% we may not have full telemetry. Compliance: estimate lost events and escalate if >1% for regulated customers.

jess: Immediate mitigation: re-add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to proxy-keystore on the new key via canary, then roll. Will run:
`gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/asia/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/ephemeral-20260323 --member="serviceAccount:proxy-keystore@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"`

ops-bot: NOTE: audit sampling change recorded user=jess before=100% after=10% id=infra/rotate-2026-03-20-11 time=2026-03-20T11:02:00Z

(3m)

jess: Canary shows unwrap OK, handshake_ok=true on canary node. Rolling rollout.

lee: Success rate rising to ~96% post-rollout. Opening INC-2026-050 for tracking: root cause IAM not propagated during rotation; contributing factor reduced sampling.

maria: Follow-ups: 1) change rotation job to copy IAM bindings; 2) add preflight `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` check; 3) avoid dropping audit sampling below 50% for mtls without exec approval.

jess: I'll open PRs and add the preflight check. Also updating rotation runbook to include IAM copy step.

compliance-bot: Reminder: attach estimated lost events and sampling window to INC-2026-050 for audit.

lee: Thanks team. Assigning to jess/maria for follow-up and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
